config.label: MQTT broker URL used by Zigbee2MQTT, e
config.description: MQTT broker URL used by Zigbee2MQTT, e.g. mqtt://192.168.1.10:1883. Supports mqtt://, mqtts://, ws:// and wss://. This is the broker, not the Zigbee2MQTT frontend port.

config.label: MQTT broker username, if the broker requires authentication
config.description: MQTT broker username, if the broker requires authentication.

config.label: MQTT broker password, if the broker requires authentication
config.description: MQTT broker password, if the broker requires authentication.

config.label: Zigbee2MQTT base topic
config.description: Zigbee2MQTT base topic. Must match mqtt.base_topic in configuration.yaml. Defaults to zigbee2mqtt.
